digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato

teaser.en: A small orchid perched on a branch like a hen brooding on her eggs, which is exactly what its Digo name says.

summary.en: *Chiahira* is the Digo word for epiphytes, plants that sit on other plants, and Pakia records it for this small coastal orchid. Mgombato records the leaves being used for earache.

about.en: *Angraecum dives* is a small epiphytic orchid. It does not root in the soil but clings to the bark of trees and shrubs with its roots exposed to the air. It has short stems with two rows of narrow, leathery leaves and bears small pale flowers with a spur at the back. Digo identify it by the look of the whole plant.

where.en: It grows on the branches of trees and bushes in the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.

uses.en: Mgombato describes *chiahira* as a plant whose leaves are bruised and twisted into small plugs, which are put in the ear as a medicine for earache. Mgombato uses the word for this kind of plant in general and doesn't name a species.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name means 'sitting on'. *Ahira* is the word used for a hen sitting on her eggs, so the orchid is pictured brooding on its host tree. The prefix *chi-* marks its small size.

names.en: *Chiahira* is not the name of one species but a group name. Digo call all epiphytic plants *chiahira* and do not give the different species their own names, even though they can see the differences. Pakia records it for two orchids, this one and the leopard orchid (*Ansellia africana*). Mgombato glosses it in Swahili as *kimelea*, a general word for plants that grow on other plants.

conservation.en: Wild orchids of the Kenya coast depend on old trees in the coastal forests, and like all orchids they are listed under CITES Appendix II.

reason.en: Mistletoe, another plant living on trees

mgombato: chiahira (vi) parasitical plant whose leaves are bruised and made into twists to be inserted into the ear as medicine for earache; kimelea chenye majani ambayo yanayofyandwa na kuingizwa sikioni kama dawa ya maumivu ya sikioni.
